question: What registration details does the OpenAI Containers sign-up require, and is the container tool available without a card?
why: platform.openai.com/signup is login-walled on every read route tried (broker login-wall, jina-keyless and browserless 502, cfbr login-wall, a probe that saw a Cloudflare challenge, and a Wayback 403); a value that only an account shows is left unverified
